args.sql:
SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS net_revenue
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

transcript.text:
West has the highest net revenue among completed orders, using the corrected definition (net revenue = amount - discount, completed orders only), so West is the primary region.
